anchor_comparisons: Both cross-sector anchors sit near their component ceiling, but they are low-confidence ordinal comparisons and cannot transfer their numeric bands to this memory commercialization case.
The positive anchor resembles execution-led rerating, while the counter anchor warns that proxy valuation narratives can overstate rerating without durable economics.
disagreements: The positive case overstates how reliably relative multiples and past underperformance convert technical execution into durable valuation recognition.
payload.rationale: Commercialization is real, but rerating durability depends on margins, allocation, customer schedules, and a comparable valuation basis. Forward PBR has already risen substantially, initial HBM4 profitability may lag HBM3E, and customer delays or supplier reviews can reduce allocation.
payload.why_not_higher: Already-expanded PBR, missing product margins, possible allocation changes, and delayed customer products constrain the duration and magnitude of rerating.
payload.why_not_lower: Mass production, continuous delivery, high-grade qualification, and realized HBM4 revenue prevent a weak commercialization assessment.
